sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: First Solar CTO Markus Gloeckler Sells 800 Shares for $160,000
feed.summary: First Solar's CTO, Markus Gloeckler, sold 800 shares of the company (NASDAQ:FSLR) for $160,000 on September 1, 2026, as part of a pre-established Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. This transaction is considered routine and not indicative of panic selling, as Gloeckler still retains a significant holding of 5,842 shares. While First Solar's stock price has declined by 7.7% over the past year, analysts are generally bullish, with a median one-year price target of $280.

feed.title: Major US summer sporting events projected to drive more than $537M in visitor spending, Expedia Group and PredictHQ research finds
feed.summary: New research by Expedia Group and PredictHQ forecasts that major US summer sporting events, including basketball, baseball, tennis, golf, and hockey, were set to generate over $537 million in visitor spending across the United States, attracting more than 4 million attendees. New York was identified as a key destination, with events in the region projected to drive over $423 million in spending, and the research highlighted a growing spillover effect of sports tourism beyond host cities. The findings emphasize that major sporting events are significant drivers of event tourism, creating substantial opportunities for destinations and travel businesses, with many bookings made well in advance.

feed.title: CarMax cuts about 60 Richmond-area jobs
feed.summary: CarMax has laid off approximately 145 corporate employees, with about 60 of those positions cut from the Richmond area. The used car retailer stated this decision was made to support strategic priorities and operate with a leaner corporate workforce, enabling faster movement and better alignment across teams. The company is offering severance, outplacement support, and opportunities to apply for internal roles to affected employees, having cut hundreds of jobs over the past year.

feed.title: Enphase Energy Drops 5% as Solar Selling Resumes; First Solar and Sunrun Fall 4%
feed.summary: Solar stocks, including Enphase Energy, First Solar, and Sunrun, experienced significant drops after the Federal Reserve's first interest rate hike in three years. This increase directly impacts residential solar financing demand, as most home solar systems are financed rather than bought outright. While the broader market remained relatively stable, the concentrated sell-off in the solar sector highlights its sensitivity to borrowing costs and the rate path.

feed.title: General Motors (GM) Bets on Software to Strengthen its Pickup Truck Franchise
feed.summary: General Motors (GM) is introducing a redesigned software experience for its 2027 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and GMC Sierra 1500 pickup trucks, aiming to expand screen real estate and simplify controls. This strategic move is intended to boost recurring software revenue and protect its profitable truck franchise, with deferred revenue from OnStar services and Super Cruise subscribers showing significant growth. While the software arm is still small compared to GM's core vehicle business, the company hopes enhanced digital experiences will improve customer retention and drive monetization through subscription services, although development costs and execution risks remain.

feed.title: Gilead Strengthens HIV Growth Platform with Expanded Latin America Access
feed.summary: Gilead Sciences, Inc. has entered an agreement with the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) to expand access to its HIV-prevention drug lenacapavir in 14 Latin American and Caribbean countries. This deal broadens the drug's commercial reach and strengthens its position as a key growth driver for Gilead, despite potential revenue and margin constraints due to lower pricing in these markets. The expansion aims to address rising HIV incidence in the region and leverages lenacapavir's twice-yearly dosing advantage for adherence, with its financial impact depending on regulatory adoption and procurement.

feed.title: Truist Reshapes Lending Strategy with $5.5B Auto-Loan Sale
feed.summary: Truist Financial Corporation is selling $5.5 billion of its auto loans to strategically reshape its lending portfolio, moving away from less profitable areas to focus on businesses with stronger and more consistent returns. This move is part of CEO Mike Lyons' broader strategy to improve profitability and reallocate capital towards higher-return activities like wealth management and investment banking. While the sale could reduce near-term revenue by decreasing earning assets, its success hinges on Truist's ability to effectively redeploy the freed-up capital into more strategic and profitable ventures.

feed.title: AbbVie’s Dividend Growth Remains Solid Despite a Moderate Yield
feed.summary: AbbVie Inc. has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.73 per share, maintaining its payout for 2026, which translates to an annual yield of around 2.7%. While the current yield is moderate, the article highlights AbbVie's consistent history of dividend growth, increasing its quarterly payout by over 330% since 2013, with the latest increase being 5.5%. The company's strong operating cash flow supports its dividends, but investors should monitor future growth rates and other capital commitments, as the dividend growth has slowed in recent years.

feed.title: Merck Advances European Regulatory Approval For Keytruda Combination In Bladder Cancer
feed.summary: Merck & Co. has received a favorable recommendation from a European regulatory committee for its cancer therapy Keytruda, in combination with Padcev, for treating adults with resectable muscle-invasive bladder cancer. This recommendation is based on positive results from the Phase 3 KEYNOTE-B15 study, showing a significant reduction in event-free survival events and risk of death compared to traditional chemotherapy. The European Commission is expected to make a final decision on marketing authorization by Q4 2026, building on prior regulatory approvals in Europe and the U.S. for related bladder cancer indications.

feed.title: Domino’s Pizza options flow shows bullish calendar spreads at $460–$480 strikes
feed.summary: Noteworthy options flow for Domino's Pizza (DPZ) reveals bullish calendar spreads at $460 and $480 strikes, indicating a contrarian bet on a significant recovery despite current bearish technicals. The trade architecture involves selling near-term calls and buying longer-dated calls, suggesting positioning for substantial upside by late 2026 or early 2027, well above the stock's 52-week high. While current technical indicators are strongly negative, the calendar spread strategy limits maximum loss and anticipates a strong catalyst for price reversal.

feed.title: Verizon’s Dividend Story: Reliable Income with Gradual Growth
feed.summary: Verizon (VZ) maintains its quarterly dividend at $0.7075 per share, offering a substantial 5.6% yield, making it an attractive option for income-focused investors. The company boasts a 20-year streak of gradual dividend increases, supported by improving free cash flow, which rose 16% in the first half of 2026. While Verizon prioritizes consistent, small increases over aggressive growth, its financial health and commitment to managing debt and network investment will influence future dividend adjustments.

feed.title: U.S. Bancorp Delivers Another Dividend Increase: Assessing the Payout
feed.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE: USB) has increased its quarterly common-stock dividend by 3.8% to $0.54 per share, resulting in an annual payout of $2.16 and a forward dividend yield of approximately 3.4%. This marks the 15th consecutive year of dividend increases for the bank, demonstrating a consistent yet measured approach to shareholder returns. The dividend is supported by a manageable payout ratio below 50%, ongoing earnings generation, and a strong capital position comfortably above regulatory minimums.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley Lowers Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE) Price Target to $100.00
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has lowered its price target for Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE) to $100.00 from $104.00, while maintaining an "overweight" rating, suggesting a potential upside of 22.69%. The utilities provider's stock is currently trading near its 52-week low at $81.50, despite beating consensus earnings estimates with $1.16 EPS for the last quarter. Analyst sentiment for Sempra Energy remains generally favorable, with a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating and an average target price of $101.69.

feed.title: Mizuho Securities Adjusts Albemarle Price Target to $140 From $160, Maintains Neutral Rating
feed.summary: Mizuho Securities has lowered its price target for Albemarle (ALB) to $140 from $160, while maintaining a Neutral rating on the specialty chemicals company. The article also notes recent leadership changes at Albemarle, including the appointment of Ragnar Udd as the new President and CEO, effective February 1, 2027. This adjustment comes amidst other analyst revisions for Albemarle.

feed.title: News Corp stock gains support from $1 billion buyback and Moderate Buy consensus
feed.summary: News Corp (NWSA) stock is trading near its 52-week high, supported by a $1 billion share repurchase program and a "Moderate Buy" consensus from analysts. The company's financial profile, including moderate debt and a recent credit rating upgrade to BBB from S&P Global Ratings, further strengthens its position. Analysts anticipate a 27.5% upside from the current price, with a 1-year target of $38.50.

feed.title: Is Rithm Capital (NYSE:RITM) Still Worth Watching?
feed.summary: Rithm Capital (NYSE: RITM) is gaining renewed attention due to its latest common and preferred dividend declarations and its expansion across various housing-related financial businesses. The company has diversified its operations beyond traditional mortgage servicing to include real estate investments, single-family rentals, and private capital. This diversification and focus on capital distribution are key themes attracting market interest, especially given the company's mixed market performance.

feed.title: GM, Ford, Stellantis Warn Through Lobbying Group That Chinese Auto Plants Could Hurt US Automakers
feed.summary: GM, Ford, and Stellantis, through their lobbying group the American Automotive Policy Council, are expressing strong opposition to Chinese automakers building plants in the U.S. They argue that this would harm Detroit automakers, American factory workers, and domestic industry competitiveness due to perceived advantages Chinese companies receive from currency manipulation and state subsidies. This stance contrasts with former President Trump's conditional openness to Chinese auto plants in the U.S. as long as they employ American workers.

feed.title: Suspects arrested in Shelby Township Ulta theft reportedly wanted in thefts across Michigan
feed.summary: Two individuals, Paula Rodriguez and Richard Monlina from Detroit, have been arrested in Shelby Township, Michigan, in connection with thefts from Ulta Beauty stores. Police say the suspects are linked to over $27,000 in stolen merchandise from various Ulta locations across the country, including Alabama. The arrests were made on September 14, following an investigation that began on September 1, utilizing FLOCK cameras and inter-agency cooperation.

feed.title: MGM heads to Shenzhen. More no-game hotels on the cards in Asia?
feed.summary: MGM has launched MGM Shenzhen Prince Bay, a non-gaming hotel in China, signaling an accelerated expansion of its asset-light model in Asia. This move follows a restructuring where MGM's non-gaming unit came under MGM China's full ownership, aiming to significantly grow its presence beyond mainland China after nearly two decades of limited development. The new hotel features extensive event spaces, ocean-view rooms, and diverse dining options, positioned to boost business and cultural tourism in the Greater Bay Area.

feed.title: Nevada: Las Vegas room rates still soft, survey shows
feed.summary: A recent Truist Securities report indicates that Las Vegas hotel room rates continue to be soft, particularly for MGM Resorts International and Caesars Entertainment, while Wynn Resorts is outperforming due to the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The report details significant rate declines for the third quarter and September, especially for midweek stays and lower-tier rooms. Despite some encouraging October numbers tied to NFL games, November advance bookings show a mixed picture, with Wynn strong but MGM and Caesars still struggling.

feed.title: Winners And Losers Of Q2: Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) Vs The Rest Of The Waste Management Stocks
feed.summary: This article analyzes the Q2 performance of several waste management stocks, highlighting Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) as a key player. It delves into the financial results of RSG, Clean Harbors (NYSE:CLH), Perma-Fix (NASDAQ:PESI), Waste Management (NYSE:WM), and Quest Resource (NASDAQ:QRHC), discussing their revenues, EBITDA, and stock performance post-earnings. The piece concludes with a brief market update on prevailing investor concerns.

feed.title: Insight Enterprises (NSIT) Is Up 2.73% in One Week: What You Should Know
feed.summary: Insight Enterprises (NSIT) has shown strong momentum, increasing by 2.73% in the past week and 5.73% in the last month, outperforming the Zacks Retail - Mail Order industry. The company also boasts a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) and a Momentum Style Score of B, supported by positive earnings estimate revisions from analysts. Investors looking for short-term growth potential may find NSIT to be a promising pick.

feed.title: SanDisk Jumps 6% as Storage Bid Concentrates in One Name; Western Digital Rises 3%, Micron Ticks Up
feed.summary: SanDisk's stock surged 6% on Friday morning, significantly outperforming other memory sector companies like Western Digital (up 3%) and Micron (up 1%). This concentrated buying in SanDisk appears to be momentum-driven rather than tied to any specific news, filing, or broader sector trend, as indicated by the muted performance of the Roundhill Memory ETF and a slight decline in the S&P 500. SanDisk's substantial 622% year-to-date gain has created a shareholder base that reacts strongly to momentum.

feed.title: Oregon woman alleges Apple AirTag enabled stalking by ex
feed.summary: A Medford woman is suing Apple Inc., alleging her ex-boyfriend used an Apple AirTag to stalk her by secretly attaching it to her car. The lawsuit claims Apple failed to implement adequate anti-stalking safeguards despite receiving over 40,000 stalking reports involving AirTags, and seeks compensatory damages and a court order to block sales without better protections. This case is one of more than 30 similar lawsuits filed against Apple after a class-action suit was declined in March.

feed.title: Intuit Reaffirms Fiscal 2027 Outlook: Is INTU a Buy or Hold From Here?
feed.summary: Intuit (INTU) has reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook, expecting 9-10% revenue growth and 23-24% non-GAAP EPS growth, driven by AI and higher-value services across its product ecosystem. Despite a significant year-to-date stock decline of 52%, the company's valuation has become more reasonable, and its growth engines continue to expand. However, concerns remain regarding slower customer additions, pressure on TurboTax market share, and a weak Mailchimp outlook, suggesting a "Hold" stance for current investors until execution improves.

feed.title: American Tower Corporation Announces Election of Kristen M. Ludgate to Board of Directors and Declares Quarterly Distribution
feed.summary: American Tower Corporation announced the election of Kristen M. Ludgate to its Board of Directors. Ms. Ludgate brings extensive experience in governance, talent strategy, and enterprise transformation from her previous roles at HP Inc. and 3M Company. The company's Board also declared a quarterly cash distribution of $1.79 per share, payable on October 20, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 30, 2026.

feed.title: Japan Post Holdings sells $1.62m of Aflac stock
feed.summary: Japan Post Holdings Co., Ltd., a 10% owner and director of Aflac Inc., sold $1.62 million worth of Aflac common stock in two transactions on September 16, 2026. Following these sales, Japan Post Holdings indirectly holds over 50.5 million shares of Aflac. This divestment occurs amidst Aflac's recent mixed Q2 2026 earnings report and concerns raised by analysts like Wolfe Research regarding its Japan operations.

feed.title: Nordson (NDSN) Down 6.9% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
feed.summary: Nordson (NDSN) shares have dropped 6.9% since its last earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500. The company reported strong Q3 fiscal 2026 results, beating revenue and earnings estimates with broad organic growth across all segments, especially Advanced Technology Solutions. Nordson has raised its fiscal 2026 guidance, expecting continued strong sales and earnings growth, leading to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating for the stock.

feed.title: Ingalls Shipbuilding’s Virtual Reality Welding Lab Surpasses 1,000 Trainees
feed.summary: HII's Ingalls Shipbuilding division has announced that its Virtual Reality (VR) Welding Lab has surpassed 1,000 trainees since opening in January 2025. This milestone highlights the success of the investment in advanced training technology, supported by collaborations with the U.S. Navy, AccelerateMS, and Mississippi Gulf Coast Community College. The VR program significantly enhances welder training, offering up to ten times more hands-on practice in a safe environment, and is a cornerstone of Ingalls' workforce development strategy.

feed.title: Microsoft ‘preserving its ability’ to challenge data center transmission costs decision
feed.summary: Microsoft has filed a notice of appeal with the Virginia Supreme Court to preserve its right to challenge a decision by the Virginia State Corporation Commission. The SCC's order mandates Dominion Energy to directly assign some transmission costs to large-load facilities like data centers. Microsoft aims to ensure that any future rates are transparent, fair, and reflect actual costs, while other major tech companies like Google have expressed conditional support for the SCC's decision.

feed.title: Could Welltower (NYSE:WELL) Reshape the Healthcare Real Estate Story?
feed.summary: Welltower Inc. (NYSE:WELL) is a healthcare-focused real estate investment trust specializing in senior housing, outpatient medical facilities, and post-acute care properties. The company's recent quarterly figures showed strong sales growth, though adjusted per-unit financial performance was mixed. Welltower's business model is closely tied to demographic changes, particularly an aging population, and its dividend activity remains a significant part of its financial profile.

feed.title: StubHub shares tick higher for third day in a row after Citi upgrade
feed.summary: StubHub shares rose for the third consecutive day after Citi analyst Jason Bazinet upgraded the stock to "buy" from "neutral." Despite trimming the price target, the new target still implies an 18% upside. The upgrade is attributed to strong app downloads during the World Cup and third quarter, as well as a robust summer sports and concert season, leading to expectations of adjusted EBITDA exceeding analyst forecasts.

feed.title: AbbVie Highlights New Real-World Data Supporting the Effectiveness of VRAYLAR® at Psych Congress 2026
feed.summary: AbbVie presented new real-world data at Psych Congress 2026 for its drug VRAYLAR (cariprazine), demonstrating its effectiveness in improving depressive symptoms, functioning, and quality of life in adults with major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar I (BP-I) depression. These studies, CReW BP-I and ProACt, reinforce that the benefits observed in clinical trials translate to real-world clinical practice, providing confidence for healthcare providers in making individualized treatment decisions. The presentations also included an indirect comparative analysis in MDD, long-term pediatric safety data, and patient preference research, highlighting VRAYLAR's role as an important treatment option for mood disorders.

feed.title: Recent Report Shows That Sen. Alan Armstrong Bought Up to $65K Worth of Williams Companies Stock
feed.summary: Senator Alan Armstrong recently purchased Williams Companies (NYSE: WMB) stock worth between $16,002 and $65,000 on August 20, 2026. This transaction is part of his extensive trading activity over the past three years, which totals over $8.52 million and includes significant dealings in Williams Companies and Apple stock. Congressional transactions provide insights for investors, though they should not be the sole basis for investment decisions.

feed.title: Palo Alto Networks, Oracle among market cap stock movers on Friday
feed.summary: On Friday, the market saw varied performance among stocks, with Avago Technologies gaining while Palo Alto Networks and Oracle Corp experienced declines. The article categorizes major stock movers by market capitalization, highlighting both large-cap gainers and small-cap decliners. This analysis provides a snapshot of market dynamics driven by investor sentiment across different company sizes.

feed.title: TJX CEO: Distribution model will help weather El Niño
feed.summary: TJX Companies CEO Ernie Herrman stated that the off-price retailer's warehouse distribution model, also known as the "hold and flow" model, provides flexibility to manage inventory in response to unpredictable events like El Niño. This strategy allows TJX to store goods in warehouses and dispatch them to stores based on real-time data, weather patterns, and demand, giving them better control than traditional retailers who often send inventory directly to stores. This approach contrasts with the "flow-through" model where inventory quickly moves through distribution centers, and some retailers use a hybrid approach depending on product variability.

feed.title: ANOTHER WORKER TAKES ON FORD ‘PLANTATION’
feed.summary: Tracy Potter, a former Ford Motor Company employee, has filed a federal lawsuit against the automaker, becoming the fourth Black woman this year to sue Ford’s Chicago Assembly Plant. Potter alleges age and disability discrimination, retaliation, and failure to accommodate, after being terminated shortly before her 30-year anniversary. Her case highlights broader accusations of systemic discrimination and hostile working conditions at the plant, which workers are calling a "modern-day plantation."

feed.title: Day in the Life: Edward Finnegan, Regional Safety Manager at Sturgeon Electric California Sep 18, 2026
feed.summary: This article highlights Edward Finnegan's role as Regional Safety Manager at Sturgeon Electric California, emphasizing his teamwork-driven approach, which stems from his Marine Corps background. It notes that he has fostered a strong culture of collaboration during his three-and-a-half years with the company. The article is an abstract, requiring a click to access the full version.

feed.title: Automaker Stocks Reverse as Rotation Trade Unwinds: General Motors and Stellantis Fall 4%, Ford Pulls Back
feed.summary: Automaker stocks, including Stellantis, General Motors, and Ford, experienced a reversal on Friday morning, giving back gains from a Thursday rotation rally. Stellantis and GM each fell 4%, while Ford pulled back 2%, as the cyclical trade unwound without any company-specific news. This decline mirrors Thursday's rally in reverse, with all three automakers falling faster than the consumer discretionary sector and the broader market.

feed.title: Kroger is no longer stocking Red Bull and the reason may surprise you
feed.summary: Kroger has stopped stocking Red Bull energy drinks in its stores and gas stations nationwide. The supermarket giant cites issues with its suppliers over affordable pricing, with an employee suggesting a dispute with Red Bull over wholesale prices. This move is believed to be a strategy by Kroger to resist Red Bull's potential price increase.

feed.title: First Western Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ:MYFW) Given Consensus Recommendation of "Hold" by Brokerages
feed.summary: First Western Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ:MYFW) has received a consensus "Hold" rating from five brokerages, with an average 12-month price target of $32.33, slightly above its current share price of $30.31. The company recently reported quarterly earnings that beat expectations at $0.57 EPS but missed on revenue forecasts. Insider activity includes CEO Scott Wylie selling 10,000 shares, while institutional investors like Wellington Management Group increased their stakes.

feed.title: T‑Mobile Appoints Chris Sambar Chief Enterprise Officer and Evolves Leadership Team to Advance its Next Era of Strategic Growth and Innovation
feed.summary: T-Mobile has appointed Chris Sambar as Chief Enterprise Officer to lead its SMB, enterprise, and government businesses, as well as scale emerging growth opportunities. This leadership team evolution aims to accelerate T-Mobile's expansion, particularly in AI and 6G technologies, and strengthen its differentiation for customers. André Almeida has also been appointed to an expanded role as Chief Marketing, Brand & Broadband Officer, while Mike Katz will transition out of his role.

feed.title: Home Depot offers free trade education to tweens and teens
feed.summary: The Home Depot Foundation is launching a "Path to Pro Skills Explorers" curriculum to introduce 15 million young people, aged 11–17, to skilled construction trades by 2032. This free, hands-on educational experience, developed with Scouting America and Boys & Girls Clubs of America, provides modules in areas like woodworking, plumbing, and electrical work. The initiative aims to address the skilled labor gap by engaging middle and high school students in career exploration.

feed.title: General Mills Q1 2027 Earnings Preview — September 23, Street Expects $0.72 EPS
feed.summary: General Mills is set to report its fiscal first-quarter 2027 earnings on September 23, with Wall Street analysts expecting $0.72 EPS on revenue of $4.35 billion. While the consensus EPS estimate has slightly increased over the last 30 days, a 10% decline over 90 days points to recalibrated expectations and potential business headwinds. Investors will be closely watching volume-price mix, gross margins, and updated full-year guidance to assess the company's performance in a challenging packaged foods market.

feed.title: Maze Therapeutics stock hits 52-week low at 22.44 USD
feed.summary: Maze Therapeutics Inc. stock has plummeted to a 52-week low of 22.44 USD, marking a 58% drop from its 52-week high and a 51.64% six-month decline. feed.title: Chevron vs. Exxon: Which Dividend Survives the Downturn
feed.summary: This article compares the dividend durability of oil giants Chevron (CVX) and Exxon Mobil (XOM) for retirement investors. While Chevron currently offers a higher yield, Exxon Mobil is deemed more durable due to its stronger balance sheet, lower leverage, higher interest coverage, and a more integrated business model with significant cash flow from its Guyana assets. Exxon's longer track record of dividend increases through commodity downturns also gives it an edge in sustainability.

feed.title: Steel Dynamics Raises Q3 Earnings Guidance on Strong Demand
feed.summary: Steel Dynamics (STLD) has significantly raised its Q3 2026 earnings guidance to $5.34-$5.38 per share, citing strong steel margins, record shipments, and resilient demand across various sectors. While metals recycling earnings are expected to decline, steel fabrication and aluminum operations are set to improve, with new aluminum capacity coming online. TipRanks' AI Analyst, Spark, rates STLD as Neutral due to solid but not peak-cycle financial performance and weak technicals, despite positive Q2 execution and H2/2027 guidance related to the aluminum ramp.

feed.title: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Expands Workforcelinc Intermodal Technician Training Program to Baltimore in Partnership with Cmc
feed.summary: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation's WorkforceLinc division is expanding its intermodal technician training program to the Port of Baltimore, partnering with CMC. This expansion builds on existing collaborations in Savannah, GA; Charleston, SC; and Wilmington, NC, aiming to deliver consistent, hands-on training directly within port operating environments. Since its launch in 2024, the program has trained over 90 CMC technicians, and the Baltimore expansion is expected to further enhance workforce development in key logistics hubs.

feed.title: Caterpillar's Robot Trucks Are Heading to Two More Quarries. Should You Buy the Dip Under $800?
feed.summary: Caterpillar is expanding its autonomous haul truck operations to two additional quarries, yet the company's stock performance is primarily driven by its Power & Energy segment, particularly sales of power generation equipment for data centers. Despite a strong stock run and significant backlog, the article questions whether the current dip under $800 is a buying opportunity given the high valuation and existing tariff headwinds. The bull case relies on the AI power capex cycle and extensive backlog, while the bear case points to the stock already pricing in good news and the cyclical nature of machinery demand.
